source_text: 近年来，中国越来越多的城市着力打造“15分钟便民生活圈(convenient living circles ) ” 。社区 居民步行15分钟就能享受到日常所需的公共服务。生活圈内建有便利店、公园、健身场地、图书馆、 学校、社区食堂、诊所等。生活圈的建立能够为居民提供更加便利、舒适、友好、愉悦的生活环境， 更好地满足城市居民多元化的日常生活服务需求，提升居民的生活品质和幸福感。
reference_translation: In recent years, more and more cities in China have been focusing on building "15-minute convenient living circles". Community residents can enjoy the public services they need in daily life within a 15-minute walk. There are convenience stores, parks, fitness areas, libraries, schools, community canteens, clinics and so on in these living circles. The establishment of these living circles can provide residents with a more convenient, comfortable, friendly and pleasant living environment, better meet the diverse daily service needs of urban residents, and improve their quality of life and sense of well-being.
